ideas.pitch: AI-powered satellite and local sensor monitoring platform for industrial land compliance, built specifically for regional industrial zones.
ideas.title: Digdoh-Industry-Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact blueprint of GeoNex-ATLAS which won by addressing local state industrial monitoring needs.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered personalized nutrition and wellness platform tailored specifically for regional diet habits and mess food availability.
ideas.title: NutriLocal-PCE
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of E-Foodiee-AI-Nutrition-Assistant by focusing on hyper-localized practical health use cases.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent student support and administrative query platform combining LangGraph and local RAG to automate college navigation.
ideas.title: Campus-Agent-Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies the multi-agent student support architecture that won the GreenNovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered patient acquisition and trust engine designed for local dental and healthcare clinics in Digdoh.
ideas.title: ClinicTrust-PCE
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the rapid 12-hour winning mechanics of Global-Smile by delivering an immediate go-to-market utility for local businesses.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous task marketplace with smart contract escrow payments built for college students to outsource small gigs securely.
ideas.title: MicroEscrow-PCE
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven autonomous marketplace and escrow architecture seen in the Synthesis Hackathon winner Dispatch.
